key_insight: AgentODE uses an LLM plus iterative inference to discover ODE structure and parameter distributions from summary statistics alone, not individual-level data.
clinical_relevance: This could help model rare diseases more interpretablely and privately when patient-level data are scarce, noisy, or hard to share.
method: Tool-augmented agent refines parameter distributions in a diagnosis–update loop
Uses population-level summary statistics to capture heterogeneity
evidence_signal: The approach was tested on three benchmark problems and two clinical datasets, including RDEB with only 231 observations from 46 patients, and recovered functionally consistent ODEs.
watch_item: Results depend on summary-statistic quality and LLM-generated structure proposals, so implausible models may still arise without careful validation.
paper_title: LLM-Guided ODE Discovery and Parameter Inference from Small-Cohort Aggregate Data
